name: manual_5e44ea
claim: To invoke Kimi (Moonshot AI) for a review/coding task, use the native ~/.kimi-code/bin/kimi CLI directly (kimi --output-format text -p '<prompt>'), NOT openclaw agent --model openrouter/moonshotai/kimi-k2.6 — the latter fails with 'Model override is not allowed for agent main' because openclaw's main agent has a model allowlist. Also: -p/--prompt cannot be combined with -y/--yolo (errors 'Cannot combine --prompt with --yolo'); omit -y for read-only review prompts.

decisions.notes: Discovered 2026-07-12 mid-dispatch of a 3-voice (Codex/Kimi/Claude) parallel Eng review for PR #205: first attempt routed Kimi through openclaw's main agent and failed silently into stderr with a routing-policy error; user then supplied 'which kimi' output pointing at the real CLI. Second attempt failed on flag conflict. Third attempt (no -y) succeeded.
